subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mandeep has repaired the truck.

options.text: The truck had been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck is been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck has been repaired by Mandeep.
The truck have been repaired by Mandeep.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Mandeep has repaired the truck." is in active voice.
 
• In passive voice, the object of the sentence (the truck) becomes the subject, and the verb takes on its past participle form (has been repaired).
 
• The original actor of the sentence (Mandeep) moves to the end of the sentence following a "by."
 
• Therefore, the correct conversion to passive voice would be, "The truck has been repaired by Mandeep."

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "The truck had been repaired by Mandeep." While this is in passive voice, it shifts the tense from present perfect to past perfect, implying a different time frame.
 
• Option 2: "The truck is been repaired by Mandeep." This option is grammatically incorrect; "is been" isn't a proper passive construction.
 
• Option 4: "The truck have been repaired by Mandeep." This is also grammatically incorrect; it should be "has been" for a singular subject ("the truck") not "have been."
